plainTranslation: The Neptune person can inspire the Sun person and make them feel seen through a softer, more beautiful lens. The risk is projection: loving an image, a fantasy, or a version of the Sun person that cannot stay human. Keep checking the actual behavior.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Refined from approved project relationship source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
